node.title: Re: Pick up specific file name
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
Just specify the wildcard mask to [doc://glob]: for my $filename (glob "$folder/*_0828900840_*D602BG") {

BTW, Using <...> for glob is confusing and might break. See [https://perl6.org/archive/rfc/34.html|Angle brackets should not be used for file globbing].
